title: Bridge-Toll Runt
text: A junior collector in an oversized ledger mask blocks the lane and demands payment with trembling authority.
flavor: The mask is official. The fear inside it is not.

defeatReward.text: You overrule the runt's false writ and note the bridge office seal.

imagePrompt: A small nervous toll collector in an oversized black ledger mask holding a brass writ on a ruined bridge checkpoint, absurd but grim gothic sci-fantasy
